title: Two CommandBarSections with a level that is not a number
exercises: The default row of EXP-021 parses the level: 'abc' makes the factory of the type's template throw a FormatException, the Lazy keeps it, and the second item of the type gets the same exception without a request (EXP-062). The exception is not a CItemException, so it ends the run through the aggregate handler of EXP-556 as a warning. No file is written.
